detail.longDescription: 22 builds today for RBs. More than half of them failed – most due to Github's LLM agents having party-time, blocking resources, having clones & downloads fail. Especially lucky are devs of Flutter apps, because in 75% of the cases it's the Flutter clone that fails… What did their CEO say? "We use LLMs, and you'll be left behind"? At least that's what we see. A Git forge where Git operations are failing because of LLM agent activity. What was a Git forge for? 🤔 # GitHub # LLM # Reliability
